candidate_windows.window_text: We used vLLM (Kwon et al., 2023) for inference pipeline for our open sourced models. Across experiments, we set temperature at 0 and $top_{p} = 1$ . All inferences were done on 40 GB A100 GPUs with FP16 quantization of the models. While generating the long form explanation to the prompt (with Llama and Mistral), we keep maximum number of tokens at 2048. For the GPT3.5 and GPT4 models, we use the Azure OpenAI platform. We set temperature=0, top_p=0.95, frequency_penalty=0 and presence_penalty=0.
